description: List all configured HTTP servers with their names, listen addresses, route counts, and TLS status. Use this to discover server names before calling route tools. The TLS label assumes Caddy's default http_port 80 and https_port 443: on a config that sets a custom apps/http http_port or https_port it can be wrong, so use caddy_status, which reads them, for an accurate label.
name: caddy_list_servers
